description.value: New Brandiz Fast Food is a fast food spot on East Hastings Street in Vancouver's busy urban corridor. The restaurant offers indoor seating and has an ATM on site, making it a handy stop for cyclists who need cash or a sit-down break. Its location on Hastings places it along a common east-west cycling route through the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL resolves to an Instagram profile (@newbrandiz) but the fetched content consists entirely of Instagram's generic login/landing pages — no business-specific content was accessible. All substantive evidence therefore comes from OSM tags: the place is tagged amenity=fast_food with indoor_seating=yes, outdoor_seating=no, and atm=yes; looks_closed=false and opening_hours are present confirming the listing is active. No phone or email is recorded in OSM, and no amenity details can be confirmed from the inaccessible Instagram content.
concerns: Instagram URL (https://www.instagram.com/newbrandiz/) returned only generic Instagram login/landing pages during prefetch — no business-specific profile content was accessible, so no amenities or contact details could be confirmed from the website.
No phone number or email recorded in OSM; contact information is sparse.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible fast food restaurant on a major Vancouver street with an active OSM record and no indication of closure.
